name: WorkInGYM
schedule: Sunday A / Monday walk / Tuesday B / Wednesday walk / Thursday C / Friday rest / Saturday cardio by default.
progression: Full volume from week 1. Stop each set with 1-2 reps left. Add weight after reaching the top of the range on every set. Pull-ups: add one rep to one set each week up to 5 x 5, then 4 x 6-8, then add weight.
warmUp: Chin tucks 2 × 10 (head straight back, hold 2 s) and band pull-aparts 2 × 20. Before any lift marked Heavy or Main, do 2 lighter warm-up sets.
finish: Doorway chest stretch 2 × 30 s per side (elbow at shoulder height) and half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch 30 s per side (squeeze the glute).
cardio: At least 120 minutes a week: 60-minute cardio day plus two 30-minute brisk walks.

weekGuidance.label: Find your working weights
weekGuidance.guidance: Full volume from day one. Choose loads where every set ends with 1–2 clean reps left. Log every set so next week has a target.

weekGuidance.label: Beat last week
weekGuidance.guidance: Add reps within the range before adding weight. Pull-ups: add one rep to one set. Assisted dips: use a little less assistance when 3 × 8 feels easy.

weekGuidance.label: Add weight when earned
weekGuidance.guidance: When every set reaches the top of its range with 1–2 reps left, use the smallest weight increase next session.

weekGuidance.label: Four-week check-in
weekGuidance.guidance: Note which lifts rose and which stalled, your pull-up max, session length, any joint pain, energy and your average weight. Use them to adjust the plan.

weekGuidance.label: Keep the progression going
weekGuidance.guidance: Progress one thing at a time: reps, then load. Keep the same machines and settings so your logs stay comparable.

weekGuidance.label: Keep building · review often
weekGuidance.guidance: If lifts stall for two weeks and joints ache, do one lighter week with half the sets. Rescan and repeat blood tests around week 12.

days.title: Squat + upper chest
days.summary: Legs go first while you are fresh. Then incline pressing for the upper chest, lats for width, and posture work. Exercises marked Pair are alternated back-to-back.

exercises.name: Hack squat or Smith squat
exercises.cue: Heavy lift. Ribs down, controlled depth, knees track over toes. Two lighter warm-up sets first.

demo.title: How To Do A MACHINE HACK SQUAT | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide
demo.note: No hack squat machine? A Smith-machine squat with feet slightly forward works the same muscles.

exercises.name: Incline Smith press
exercises.cue: Low incline. Lower the bar to your upper chest, shoulder blades pinned back.

demo.title: How to do incline smith machine bench press

exercises.name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull toward your upper chest, elbows down and in. No swinging.

demo.title: How To Do A Close Grip (Neutral) Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.cue: Knees in line with the machine pivot. Control the curl and the return.

demo.title: Seated Leg Curl Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cue: Pair with calf raise. Pause briefly at the top, lower slowly.

demo.title: How To Do A Leg Extension

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Pair with leg extension. Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

demo.title: How To Do A Calf Raise

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cue: Pair with face pull. Light weights, no swinging or shrugging.

demo.title: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Pair with lateral raise. Rope to your forehead, squeeze the shoulder blades together.

demo.title: How to do a Face Pull | Proper Form & Technique | NASM

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.cue: Pair with farmer's carry. Curl your pelvis up rather than just lifting the knees. No swinging.

demo.title: How To Do Hanging Knee Raises

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.cue: Pair with knee raise. Heavy dumbbells, stand tall, short steps. No straps.

demo.title: How To Do A Farmer's Walk (Farmer's Carry)

days.title: Walk + bands
days.summary: Brisk 30-minute walk — it counts toward your 120 cardio minutes a week, the minimum for HDL to rise. Optional 10-minute band routine: band face pull 2 × 15, wall slides 2 × 10, thoracic extension 2 × 8, chin tucks 2 × 10, doorway chest and hip-flexor stretches.

days.title: Pull-ups + hinge
days.summary: Pull-ups are the main lift. Start at 5 sets of 2 and add one rep to one set each week until you reach 5 × 5, then move to 4 × 6–8.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cue: Main lift. Full hang to chin over the bar, no swinging. Stop one rep before failure. Add a rep to one set each week.

demo.title: How to Do a Perfect Pull-Up – Complete Beginner's Guide

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Heavy lift. Barbell or dumbbells. Push your hips back, flat back, weights close to your legs. No straps.

demo.title: How to do a Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift | Proper Form & Technique | NASM
demo.note: The demo uses dumbbells; a barbell Romanian deadlift works the same way.

exercises.name: Smith machine split squat
exercises.cue: Front foot flat on the floor, back knee travels down. The fixed bar removes the balance problem.

demo.title: Smith Machine Split Squat
demo.source: Women's Strength Nation by Holly Perkins

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Low incline. Press up and slightly in, wrists stacked over elbows.

demo.title: How To Do An Incline Dumbbell Press

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.cue: Chest stays on the pad. Squeeze the shoulder blades together without shrugging.

demo.title: How To Do An Incline Row (Chest Supported Row)
demo.note: The demo uses dumbbells on an incline bench. A chest-supported row machine is also suitable.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cue: Pair with lateral raise. Open the arms smoothly, no shrugging.

demo.title: Reverse Pec Deck

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cue: Pair with reverse pec deck. Light weights, no swinging or shrugging.

demo.title: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Kneeling cable crunch
exercises.cue: Pair with wrist curls. Round your spine to bring ribs toward hips; the hips stay still.

demo.title: Exercise Tutorial: Kneeling Cable Crunch

exercises.name: Wrist curl
exercises.cue: Forearms on a bench, palms up. Slow, full range.

demo.title: How To Perform Wrist Curls And Reverse Wrist Curls With Dumbbells
demo.note: The same video shows the reverse wrist curl.

exercises.name: Reverse wrist curl
exercises.cue: Forearms on a bench, palms down. Lighter weight, slow, full range.

demo.title: How To Perform Wrist Curls And Reverse Wrist Curls With Dumbbells
demo.note: The reverse wrist curl is the second half of the video.

days.title: Walk + bands
days.summary: Brisk 30-minute walk — it counts toward your 120 cardio minutes a week, the minimum for HDL to rise. Optional 10-minute band routine: band face pull 2 × 15, wall slides 2 × 10, thoracic extension 2 × 8, chin tucks 2 × 10, doorway chest and hip-flexor stretches.

days.title: Legs + dips
days.summary: Leg press goes first. Pull-up practice, glutes and hamstrings, then assisted dips, arms and core.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Heavy lift. Pelvis stays on the pad. Do not lock your knees at the top — your scan shows mild knee hyperextension.

demo.title: How To Do A 45 Degree Leg Press
demo.note: The demo uses a 45-degree machine. Ask staff to show you the settings on your gym’s model.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cue: Stop one rep before failure, then go straight to the band-assisted sets.

demo.title: How to Do a Perfect Pull-Up – Complete Beginner's Guide

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-ups
exercises.cue: Loop the band under a knee or foot. Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

demo.title: Resistance Band Assisted Pullups

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.cue: Hang as long as you can with the shoulders active, not shrugged up to your ears.

demo.title: How To: Dead Hang Exercise

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on a bench, ribs down, chin tucked. Squeeze the glutes hard at the top.

demo.title: How to do a Hip Thrust CORRECTLY - Complete Step-by-Step Guide

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.cue: Knees in line with the machine pivot. Control the curl and the return.

demo.title: Seated Leg Curl Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Assisted dips
exercises.cue: Pair with hammer curl. Machine or band. Lower until upper arms are parallel, lean slightly forward. Front-shoulder pain: stop and do a flat dumbbell press.

demo.title: Exercise Tutorial: Assisted Dips
demo.note: No machine? Loop a band across the dip bars and kneel on it.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.cue: Pair with dips. Palms face each other, upper arms still, lower slowly.

demo.title: How To Do Hammer Curls

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Pair with lateral raise. Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

demo.title: How To Do A Calf Raise

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cue: Pair with calf raise. Light weights, no swinging or shrugging.

demo.title: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Rope triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Pair with side plank. Elbows by your sides, spread the rope at the bottom.

demo.title: Tricep Pushdown - Rope

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: Pair with pushdown. Straight line from head to feet; stop before the hips sag.

demo.title: How To Do A Side Plank
demo.note: Too hard at first? Bend your knees and build up.

days.title: Rest
days.summary: Full rest. Eat your normal menu and sleep 7–9 hours — recovery is when the muscle is built.

days.title: Cardio day
days.summary: 60 minutes on the bike or an incline walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing. Longer sessions raise HDL the most; prefer bike or walking to running while you bulk.
